title: Provider interfaces (LLM and STT abstract base classes & contracts)

test_cases.name: ABC instantiation enforcement
test_cases.input_setup: Attempt direct instantiation of abstract class LLMProvider()
test_cases.expected_result: TypeError raised: Can't instantiate abstract class with abstract methods
test_cases.evidence: Instantiating LLMProvider ABC raises TypeError as expected

test_cases.name: Abstract methods contract inspection
test_cases.expected_result: complete, stream, health_check, and close are declared abstract

test_cases.name: HealthResult immutability
test_cases.input_setup: Attempt to mutate 'ok' attribute on ProviderHealthResult instance
test_cases.expected_result: FrozenInstanceError / exception raised on mutation attempt
test_cases.evidence: ProviderHealthResult is an immutable frozen dataclass; mutations rejected

test_cases.name: Foundry provider contract implementation
test_cases.expected_result: Instantiates cleanly without TypeError; satisfies all LLMProvider contracts
test_cases.evidence: FoundryLLMProvider successfully implements all abstract methods without TypeError

test_cases.name: STT provider contracts validation
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect MunsitSTTProvider and VoxtralSTTProvider method interfaces
test_cases.expected_result: Both providers implement transcribe_live_ar, transcribe_live_en, and health_check
test_cases.evidence: Both MunsitSTTProvider and VoxtralSTTProvider implement all STT interface methods
